reading.body:
DISKUS Polska is an unverified OpenStreetMap data center record in Wieliczka, Poland, with no confirmed power capacity and no confirmed operator.

The record carries a name, a coordinate, a website, and an OpenStreetMap tag of telecom=data_center. Nothing else about it has been confirmed. The capacity field is zero, which here means unknown rather than empty, and the research note states plainly that the operator website could not be checked because search quota ran out. The name is suggestive of storage, and the town sits near Kraków, a real technology and outsourcing hub, but a suggestive name is not evidence of a facility.

For AI specifically, this record cannot be counted. A data center that might exist, at a size that is not stated, tells a reader nothing about available compute or the power contracted to run it. The one geographic fact worth keeping is the location: Wieliczka is 13.4 miles from Kraków John Paul II International Airport, which is the kind of siting detail that matters for latency and staff, not for capacity.

What the data does not cover is nearly everything. There is no megawatt figure, no operator, no build date, no confirmation that the tagged site is a data center at all rather than an office or a warehouse. Treat this as a lead awaiting verification, not as a facility on the map.
